description: Integrates Stonebranch UAC with ServiceNow for ITSM and CMDB operations: Create/Update Incidents, Update RITMs, and Create/Update/Get CIs via IRE.

fields.hint: Select the ServiceNow operation to perform.
fields.label: Action
fields.name: action

fields.hint: Base URL of the ServiceNow instance (e.g. https://myinstance.service-now.com). Must begin with https:// and must not include a trailing slash.
fields.label: Instance URL
fields.name: instance_url

fields.hint: UAC Credential providing the ServiceNow username (user) and password for Basic Auth.
fields.label: Credential
fields.name: credential

fields.hint: Brief one-line summary of the Incident. Maps to ServiceNow short_description.
fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: short_description

fields.hint: Detailed multi-line description of the Incident. Maps to ServiceNow description.
fields.label: Description
fields.name: description

fields.hint: Incident category. Maps to ServiceNow category (e.g. Software).
fields.label: Category
fields.name: category

fields.hint: Incident priority. Maps to ServiceNow priority (e.g. 2).
fields.label: Priority
fields.name: priority

fields.hint: Incident urgency. Maps to ServiceNow urgency (e.g. 2).
fields.label: Urgency
fields.name: urgency

fields.hint: Incident impact. Maps to ServiceNow impact (e.g. 2).
fields.label: Impact
fields.name: impact

fields.hint: ServiceNow user ID or display name of the person reporting the Incident. Maps to caller_id.
fields.label: Caller
fields.name: caller

fields.hint: ServiceNow assignment group name or sys_id. Maps to assignment_group.
fields.label: Assignment Group
fields.name: assignment_group

fields.hint: ServiceNow user to whom the Incident is assigned. Maps to assigned_to.
fields.label: Assigned To
fields.name: assigned_to

fields.hint: The sys_id of the Incident to update. Required when action is Update Incident.
fields.label: Incident Sys ID
fields.name: incident_sys_id

fields.hint: JSON object of Incident field name-value pairs to update (e.g. {"state": "2", "work_notes": "Investigating"}). Leave empty to touch the record without changes.
fields.label: Incident Fields to Update
fields.name: incident_fields_to_update

fields.hint: The sys_id of the Request Item (RITM) to update.
fields.label: RITM Sys ID
fields.name: ritm_sys_id

fields.hint: JSON object of RITM field name-value pairs to update (e.g. {"state": "3", "approval": "approved"}). Leave empty to touch the record without changes.
fields.label: RITM Fields to Update
fields.name: ritm_fields_to_update

fields.hint: CMDB table/class for the CI. Click refresh to load available classes from ServiceNow. Format: Label (table_name).
fields.label: CI Class
fields.name: ci_class

fields.hint: Name of the Configuration Item to create or update. Accepts Stonebranch variable references (e.g. ${ops_var_vm_name}).
fields.label: CI Name
fields.name: ci_name

fields.hint: Additional CI attribute key-value pairs to include in the IRE payload. Entries with empty values are excluded.
fields.label: Attributes
fields.name: attributes

fields.hint: Discovery source identifier sent to ServiceNow IRE as the top-level source field (e.g. Stonebranch, ServiceNow Discovery). Leave empty to omit from the IRE payload.
fields.label: Data Source
fields.name: data_source

fields.hint: Determines the search mode used to locate CI records: by Name, by Sys ID, or by a custom ServiceNow encoded query string.
fields.label: Search By
fields.name: search_by

fields.hint: Value used with the selected search mode: exact name, sys_id, or raw ServiceNow encoded query string.
fields.label: Search Value
fields.name: search_value

fields.hint: Comma-separated CI field names for sysparm_fields (e.g. sys_id,name,ip_address). Leave empty to use defaults: sys_id,name,ip_address,operational_status,cpu_count,ram,os,short_description.
fields.label: Return Fields
fields.name: return_fields

fields.hint: Maximum number of CI records to return (sysparm_limit). Must be between 1 and 10000.
fields.label: Limit
fields.name: limit

fields.hint: The human-readable Incident number from ServiceNow (populated by extension).
fields.label: Incident Number
fields.name: incident_number

fields.hint: The human-readable RITM number from ServiceNow (populated by extension).
fields.label: RITM Number
fields.name: ritm_number

fields.hint: The IRE operation outcome: CREATED, UPDATED, or MATCHED (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Action
fields.name: cmdb_action

fields.hint: The sys_id of the Configuration Item created, updated, or retrieved (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Sys ID
fields.name: cmdb_sys_id

fields.hint: CMDB table/class name of the CI as confirmed by the IRE response (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Class
fields.name: cmdb_class

fields.hint: The name of the Configuration Item as confirmed by ServiceNow (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Name
fields.name: cmdb_name

fields.hint: The overall IRE operation status: SUCCESS or PARTIAL_SUCCESS (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Status
fields.name: cmdb_status

fields.hint: Operational status of the retrieved CI (populated by extension). 1=Operational, 2=Non-Operational.
fields.label: CMDB Operational Status
fields.name: cmdb_operational_status

fields.hint: CPU count of the retrieved CI (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB CPU Count
fields.name: cmdb_cpu_count

fields.hint: RAM of the retrieved CI in MB (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB RAM (MB)
fields.name: cmdb_ram

fields.hint: Total number of CI records returned by the search query (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Result Count
fields.name: cmdb_result_count

fields.hint: Complete first CI record as a sanitized JSON string (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Result JSON
fields.name: cmdb_result_json

fields.hint: All returned CI records as a sanitized JSON array string. Populated only when multiple results are returned (populated by extension).
fields.label: CMDB Results JSON
fields.name: cmdb_results_json

name: Servicenow Cmdb
